original_intent.statement: Provide a repeatable workflow for publishing code-review reports to Azure DevOps work items and pull requests, including author notification and follow-up handling.
original_intent.source: README.md changelog entries dated 2026-05-07 and 2026-06-10; original request is not present in current records.

revisions.intent: Publish code-review reports to ADO work items or pull requests. Preserve default author mentions and existing follow-up behavior. When the user explicitly says they performed the review or asks for no self-mention, use a neutral introduction, omit mention identity, and preserve that policy in state. Do not infer self-review from account or author identity.
success_criteria: Default and explicitly overridden PR mention flows continue to produce a valid author mention.
Explicit PR self-review produces a neutral introduction, full report body, mentionPolicy none, selfReview true, and null mentionGuid.
Invalid self-review plus mention overrides are rejected before publication.
Output verification accepts new self-review state and legacy author-mention state, while rejecting inconsistent policy metadata.
Dry-run output exposes full body for verification, including Unicode text returned by Azure CLI.
non_goals: No automatic self-identity inference or change to default mention behavior.
No changes to ADO PR vote/status, attachment behavior, or work-item follow-up strategy.
No installation, plugin publication, commit, push, or live comment operation by this skill-source update.

approval.source: Explicit user request on 2026-09-28 to update publish skill so self-review does not mention the reviewer.
approval.reason: Adds the explicitly requested self-review exception while retaining existing default publishing behavior and scope.

revisions.intent: Automatically detect PR self-review from authenticated ADO GUID and PR author GUID, suppress self-mentions, and retain author mentions for other PRs. Preserve explicit overrides, fail before POST when identity cannot be verified, and synchronize source, installed skills and related plugin.
success_criteria: Equal validated GUIDs automatically select neutral introduction without name or mention.
Different GUIDs preserve author mention; explicit overrides take precedence.
Missing, malformed or unavailable identity stops before POST.
Dry-run and publish expose detection provenance; legacy states remain valid.
Related installed skill and plugin copies receive validated changes.
non_goals: No matching by display names or email.
No new PR comments, PR vote/status changes or automatic WI identity detection during this update.
No unrelated skill or agent changes.

approval.source: User request on 2026-09-28 in current session: script should auto detect and sync related sources.
approval.reason: Supersedes revision1 explicit-only detection boundary and authorizes related synchronization.
